I will be the first to bash it for being large (it had a 4-6 hooker trunk, easily), poorly designed (who puts the battery below a support and then below the windshield washer fluid reservoir and the alternator next to the firewall?) and the interior looking like it was slapped together using whatever surplus parts they had lying around. It allowed me to go 13 years with no car payment and for that I'm grateful. It served me well, but its been dead for a few years now so it is fine to bash away at it.

I had intended to put a cage in it, paint it up like a late 1990s NASCAR and send it out in a blaze of glory in a LeMons race, but it died before I could make that a reality.
